content: TimescaleDB continuous aggregates (CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW ... WITH (timescaledb.continuous)) auto-refresh on a policy; add_retention_policy() drops raw chunks after an interval. Retention and aggregate refresh windows must not overlap or the aggregate loses source data before it materializes -- schedule retention drop after the aggregate refresh window with margin. TimescaleDB v2.23+ supports Postgres 15/16/17/18; avoid Postgres 17.1 specifically (reverted ABI break), use 17.2+ or 16.x.
